svg.aria-label: 2 ways to give 12 elements to 4 threads, shown as 3 steps. Top, chunks: in step 0 the 4 threads touch elements 0, 3, 6 and 9, spread over 40 bytes. Bottom, stride 4: in step 0 they touch elements 0 to 3, then 4 to 7, then 8 to 11, each step 16 neighboring bytes. Colors mark threads 0 to 3.
svg.text: Two ways to give 12 elements to 4 threads
Chunks spread each step over 40 bytes; a stride keeps it in 16.

g.text: stride 4: thread t takes t, t + 4, t + 8
